XE Series Cargo Trailer
Rear Ramp Door
The XE Series Cargo Trailer delivers smart performance and everyday reliability in a value-packed design. This enclosed trailer is built with premium construction features often missing in entry-level models, making it a smart choice for hauling cargo with confidence and style.
Key Benefits
Steel Tube Wall Studs and Roof Bows — Superior Strength Welded steel tube framing provides unmatched durability compared to cheaper stamped or formed components.Side Wall Air Flow Vents — Built-In Ventilation Improves airflow inside the enclosed trailer to help reduce heat and moisture buildup.BattleCoat Polyurea Textured Coating — Rugged Protection Polyurea coating on exposed steel defends against chips, de-icing chemicals, and road debris.VHB-Bonded Field with Color-Matching Screws — Clean Exterior Finish VHB tape and matching screws give this cargo trailer a modern look with fewer exposed fasteners.
Why Choose the XE Series Cargo Trailer?
Built for the Daily Haul Designed to balance value with durability, the XE Series is ideal for anyone looking for a dependable enclosed cargo trailer. From weekend movers to small business operators, this trailer gives you more than expected from an entry-level unit—with upgrades in construction that add lasting value.Ventilated and Versatile Side wall vents come standard to help manage temperature and airflow during transport. Whether you're hauling tools, gear, or supplies, the XE Series helps protect your cargo with proper ventilation, sealed seams, and a tough exterior that holds up against the elements.Details That Make a Difference What separates the XE Series from typical entry-level enclosed trailers is its steel tube wall studs and roof bows, giving you a solid structural frame. BattleCoat-coated exposed steel enhances rust resistance, while the VHB-bonded exterior provides a sleek, screw-free look along the sidewalls with color-matched fasteners at the seams.Confidence for Every Haul Available in multiple sizes, this enclosed trailer adapts to a wide range of needs—from everyday hauling to small-scale commercial use. With the XE Series, you get a work-ready cargo trailer that’s engineered for the long haul and built to look good doing it.
